item.title: Iran live updates: Trump threatens 'the bombing starts' if Iran doesn't make a deal
item.description: President Donald Trump first announced Project Freedom on Sunday in a post, promising the Navy would "guide their Ships safely out of these restricted Waterways."

item.title: China is stepping up its Iran war diplomacy ahead of Trump's summit with Xi
item.description: China’s diplomatic role in the Iran war has come into sharper focus after talks between Chinese and Iranian foreign ministers on Wednesday, days before U.S. President Donald Trump is expected to meet his Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping

item.title: French carrier group moves south of Suez ahead of conditional UK-French Hormuz mission
item.description: The French armed forces say that France’s aircraft carrier strike group is moving south of the Suez Canal and into the Red Sea in preparation for a potential future mission as part of a French-British plan for the Strait of Hormuz

item.title: Family fears for jailed Iranian Nobel Peace laureate's life if she's not moved to a Tehran hospital
item.description: Nobel laureate Narges Mohammadi is in critical condition in an Iranian hospital

item.title: WATCH: Woman arrested after driving on sidewalk toward child riding bike, police say
item.description: A woman was arrested last week in Spokane, Washington, after she allegedly drove onto a sidewalk and nearly hit a child who was riding a bike, police said.
